title: Retrospective evaluation of MR-guided pancreatic radiotherapy (RAMP)
summary: Data is analyzed by pooling information previously collected by various clinics or centers. This data is completely anonymous. The researchers do not intervene in treatments but simply examine what occurred in the past. The analysis is carried out centrally at a single location.

interventions.name: Treatment at the individual centers is carried out according to clinical standards. Only the resulting data are forwarded for analysis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with PDAC treated with MRgRT
Exclusion criteria:
none
